findings.summary: All prior protocol findings are closed.
findings.detail: Command ownership, append-only history, the executable SECURITY DEFINER/NOLOGIN boundary, command-specific atomic mutations and lock order, divergent S15/S44 guards, T2-GLOBAL isolation, replay/evaluation separation, and production/shadow separation conform to the frozen authorities.

findings.summary: Receipt locking follows the frozen terminal position.
findings.detail: T2-SEAL uses USER to BUILD to RECEIPT, T2 external execution uses USER to EXECUTION to RECEIPT, and T7 uses REGISTRY_SHARED to USER to EXECUTION to RECEIPT. No path acquires the receipt unique key before S01.
